title: REMOVAL OF SUN ROOF / DISASSEMBLY OF SUN ROOF

content.description: Control box assembly showing removal of center cover and control switch, with battery cable disconnect point

items: DISCONNECT BATTERY CABLE FROM NEGATIVE TERMINAL
REMOVE CENTER COVER OF CONTROL BOX
REMOVE DRIVE MOTOR THROUGH SERVICE HOLE

content.description: Sun roof assembly showing wind deflector and guide rail cover locations

items.text: REMOVE SLIDING ROOF AND GUIDE RAIL

items: (a) Apply adhesive tape to protect the body.
(b) Pull the sliding roof with the guide rail upward and forward to remove.

content.description: Hands removing sliding roof headlining by prying off clip and pulling rearward

items: (b) Pull the sliding roof headlining rearward to remove.

content.description: Removal of guide rail and cable guide casing by loosening screw and pulling forward

items.text: REMOVE GUIDE RAIL AND CABLE GUIDE CASING

items: (b) Pull the guide rail rearward to remove.
(c) Pull the cable guide casing forward to remove.

content.description: Front shoe area showing shim location for noting number of shims on front and rear

items: NOTE NUMBER OF SHIMS ON FRONT AND REAR
REMOVE DRIVE CABLE AND REAR SHOE
REMOVE DRIVE CABLES FROM CABLE GUIDE CASING
